name: The Frankie Shop
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $155 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Oversized blazers, suiting, coats, knitwear and leather jackets under its own label, blazers around $385 and coats around $550, sold mainly through its own site and stores.
origin: Founded in New York, United States in 2015 by Gaëlle Drevet.

ownership.owner: Independent (founder-owned): Gaëlle Drevet sole shareholder per Modaes 2025

quote.q: Then and now, they’ve been guided by the belief that good style is hard to define. And so are they.

opview: “Then and now, they’ve been guided by the belief that good style is hard to define. And so are they.” — The Frankie Shop (house), About, thefrankieshop.com

facts_read.source: brand site (About, lookbook, Fall Edit, terms, product page); Modaes 2025-11-20; nordstrom.com search; Vinted catalogue; TRR designer index (2026-10-13 list); B Lab directory; GOTS database

doors.note: US: 1 own door, the NYC flagship at 59 Crosby Street, SoHo 10012 — a store selling the in-house line alongside other designers. The 'Store Locator' link still points to /pages/new-york-lower-east-side, but that page now shows the SoHo address: the Lower East Side store (100 Stanton St, which other brands still list as a Frankie Shop stockist) is no longer on the brand's own site. World: Paris (women; men & lifestyle), New York SoHo, Milan (Quadrilatero), London Selfridges (concession). Worldwide stockist list has no US entries.

craft_evidence.reasoning: Nearly every product page states a country (mostly South Korea), but no maker, mill, factory or process is named. A stated country across the range with nothing behind it is a 2.
